text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: unusual spike in 401 responses from proxy-3 and a high volume of S3 GETs from role svc-logs. Potential staging log forwarder leakage. Alert: https://internal/alerts/INC-1717609999
maria: oncall here, I'm looking. pulling proxy and s3 access logs now. will confirm scope.
srini: joining — I'll run a quick leak scan on the staging bucket and tail the forwarder host.
maria: proposed mitigation plan (short): 1) stop staging log-forwarder, 2) rotate svc-logs credentials, 3) add temporary WAF block for suspect IP ranges, 4) run detailed leak scan + scrub, 5) legal notified if PII/customer tokens found. any other suggestions?
jamie: making the WAF rule now and can block the observed IPs at edge.
jamie: WAF rule created wf-3498, blocking 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24. monitoring traffic drop. :thumbsup:
maria: stopping forwarder on staging host: 
```
ssh ubuntu@log-forwarder-02
sudo systemctl stop log-forwarder
sudo systemctl disable log-forwarder
```
please do not restart until we confirm rotation.
srini: running leak scan across s3 staging bucket (quick pass):
```
aws s3api list-objects --bucket redwood-staging-logs --query 'Contents[].{Key:Key}' | jq -r '.[].Key' | xargs -n1 -I{} aws s3 cp s3://redwood-staging-logs/{} - | grep -E "(AKIA|SECRET|PRIVATE|-----BEGIN)" || true
```
found 2 files with potential key-like strings, pulling to secure host for manual review.
maria: rotating svc-logs keys now. creating replacement keys and will orphan previous ones. srini, please confirm nothing in prod depends on the old key.
srini: checking service usage map... svc-logs key appears only in staging forwarder and one CI job (ci-logs-uploader). I'll notify CI owners and update job to use the new key; blocking old key in staging immediately.
legal-lead: thanks for the ping. tag me with any files containing customer PII or tokens. we'll evaluate notification obligations. keep forensic copies offline.
ops-bot: incident ticket created: #INC-1717609999. linked runbook: https://internal/runbooks/log-forwarder-leak. escalation policy notified.
maria: preliminary customer impact assessment: no production customers appear affected based on initial checks. staging bucket contains synthetic and some scrubbed customer traces — full scan underway to be certain.
jamie: since WAF rule rolled, bad traffic against proxy-3 dropped ~85% in the last 5m.
maria: timeline so far: stop forwarder @1717610200, rotation started @1717610300, leak-scan pass1 @1717610600. collecting artifacts and packing an evidence set.
ben: i'll be oncall next shift in 2h, happy to take handoff for CI updates and final scrub. assign to me for follow-up.
maria: handing off to ben — open actions: finish CI key swap, scrub flagged staging files, validate no customer tokens, and close incident ticket once confirmed. leaving connections and commands in the ticket. :white_check_mark:
ben: ack, taking oncall at @1717613600. will run a 30m followup and report back in ticket. :eyes:
incident-bot: status update: mitigation = in progress (forwarder stopped, keys rotated, WAF blocking). active followups assigned to ben and srini. Incident ticket: #INC-1717609999. Next update scheduled in 30m.
